analysis.visual_description: The bill, on the bookwheel. A black-letter bill on the table by the window. The title, the house, and the hour. No author's name.
The bill, on the bookwheel. The lower lines name the company. There is no sum on the paper, and no receipt.
The bill, on the bookwheel. The bill stays on the table. The pen is not taken up. The door of the chamber is still shut.
